title: Handheld tape dispenser, patent pending
tagline: A one-piece, blade-free tape dispenser safe for young kids; sole inventor on US 2025/0368466 A1
summary: A compact handheld dispenser built around a mostly single-piece plastic frame: snap-on clips hold the roll, grooves in the handle show how to hold it, and a single pointed plastic tip tears the tape instead of a metal blade. I filed it as sole inventor in May 2024, while in high school; the application published in December 2025 and is pending.
role: I was responsible for the concept, the CAD and prototypes, and the patent application. [TODO: name who helped with the filing, if anyone]
goal_constraints:
- Usable by young children and people with limited motor skills.
- No metal blade; tape still tears cleanly.
- As few parts as possible so it can be molded cheaply.
